name: get-device-information
description: Inventory the local operating system, CPU, memory, hardware model, firmware, and virtualization.
flags: No script-specific flags.

name: check-hardware-health
description: Read existing SMART/NVMe health and thermal sensors without starting tests or waking standby disks.
flags: --device /dev/DEVICE (optional); --temperature-warn CELSIUS (default 80).

name: audit-drivers-and-firmware
description: Inventory loaded kernel modules, PCI drivers, network firmware versions, and recent firmware failure counts.
flags: No script-specific flags.

name: get-battery-health
description: Read battery charge, cycle count, and full-capacity versus design-capacity wear from sysfs.
flags: --wear-warning-percent PERCENT (remaining design capacity; default 80).

name: test-virtualization-readiness
description: Check CPU virtualization hints, KVM availability and permissions, and IOMMU visibility.
flags: No script-specific flags.

name: test-network-connectivity
description: Inspect interfaces, routes, and an explicitly selected TCP endpoint.
flags: --target HOST --port NUMBER (default 443); no external target is contacted unless selected.

name: audit-dns-configuration
description: Inspect active resolver settings and optional forward and reverse lookups.
flags: --name HOSTNAME --address IP --server DNS_IP; lookups use the current resolver unless --server is supplied.

name: audit-firewall-rules
description: Audit available firewall backends and local listeners without changing rules.
flags: No script-specific flags.

name: configure-static-network
description: Plan a static IPv4 Ethernet profile cloned from the active NetworkManager profile, with separate activation confirmation.
flags: --backend networkmanager --interface NAME --connection EXISTING_UUID --profile NEW_NAME --address IPv4/PREFIX --gateway IPv4 --dns IPv4[,IPv4]; --apply still asks before activation; existing profiles are preserved.
options: backend interface connection profile address gateway dns

name: test-remote-access
description: Inspect SSH service configuration and listeners, with an optional TCP reachability test.
flags: --target HOST --port NUMBER (default 22); --user USER --client-address IP --local-address IP provide an sshd Match context.

name: get-printer-inventory
description: List CUPS queues, default destination, accepting state, device endpoints, and installed driver choices.
flags: --queue NAME optionally limits queue details; installed driver listing remains global.

name: test-printer-connectivity
description: Test a selected printer TCP endpoint and optionally read-only IPP attributes.
flags: --target HOST --protocol ipp|ipps|raw (default ipp) --port NUMBER --uri ipp[s]://HOST/PATH; IPP defaults to /ipp/print and port 631, raw to 9100.

name: configure-network-printer
description: Plan or create a local CUPS queue using IPP Everywhere or an explicitly approved installed model.
flags: --queue NAME --uri ipp[s]://HOST/PATH|socket://HOST:PORT --driver MODEL (default everywhere); only creates a new unshared queue.

name: repair-print-queue
description: Plan or perform one narrow CUPS queue recovery action without deleting jobs.
flags: --queue NAME --action enable|accept|release (default enable); release asks for separate confirmation before pending jobs resume.

name: export-print-configuration
description: Export sanitized CUPS queue and security metadata into the private report directory.
flags: No script-specific flags; this is a metadata export, not a complete restorable CUPS backup.

name: audit-service-health
description: Inspect service startup, failed states, and selected service dependencies using systemd or OpenRC.
flags: --service NAME optionally selects one service for detailed state and dependency checks.

name: audit-scheduled-jobs
description: Inventory systemd timers, cron metadata, and pending at jobs without exporting scheduled command text.
flags: --user USER selects the crontab owner (default current user); run with appropriate access to inspect another user.

name: configure-service-state
description: Plan or change one selected service's startup and runtime state, with separate restart confirmation.
flags: --service NAME --enabled yes|no|keep (default keep) --state start|stop|restart|keep (default keep) --runlevel NAME (OpenRC, default default).

name: audit-web-services
description: Check installed nginx and Apache configuration syntax, listeners, and optional remote TLS certificate dates.
flags: --host HOST --port NUMBER (default 443) selects a TLS endpoint; no external endpoint is contacted otherwise.

name: audit-time-synchronization
description: Detect active time services, inspect configured sources and synchronization status, and flag competing daemons.
flags: No script-specific flags.

name: get-software-inventory
description: Inventory installed native packages and optional Flatpak and Snap applications.
flags: --include-flatpak yes|no (default no); --include-snap yes|no (default no).

name: audit-package-health
description: Check package database consistency and optionally verify a selected installed package.
flags: --package NAME (optional integrity check).

name: audit-package-repositories
description: Audit configured repository identities, trust settings, and source entries without refreshing metadata.
flags: No script-specific flags.

name: plan-system-updates
description: Plan system updates using cached metadata, held packages, free space, and restart indicators.
flags: No script-specific flags. Never installs or refreshes package indexes.

name: install-approved-software
description: Install a reviewed package manifest through the detected distribution package manager.
flags: --manifest PATH (required TSV: family and package); --profile NAME (report label, default approved).

name: get-filesystem-capacity
description: Check space and inode capacity on a selected filesystem and inventory mount types and read-only states.
flags: --path /PATH (default /); --space-warning-percent PERCENT (default 85); --inode-warning-percent PERCENT (default 85).

name: find-large-and-open-deleted-files
description: Find large files within a bounded directory scan and inventory deleted files still held open.
flags: --path /PATH (default /var/log); --minimum-mib MIB (default 100); --max-depth DEPTH (default 4, maximum 8); --limit COUNT (default 50, maximum 200); --timeout-seconds SECONDS (default 30, maximum 120).

name: audit-filesystem-permissions
description: Audit a selected tree for world-writable objects, unprotected writable directories, special executable bits, and root ACL metadata.
flags: --path /PATH (default /etc); --max-depth DEPTH (default 3, maximum 8); --limit COUNT (default 100, maximum 200); --timeout-seconds SECONDS (default 30, maximum 120).

name: audit-network-shares
description: Inspect selected Samba security settings, NFS export flags, and mounted network-share types without exposing passwords.
flags: No script-specific flags.

name: audit-storage-layout
description: Inventory block-device topology, LVM thin/snapshot capacity, MD RAID, Btrfs, and ZFS where present.
flags: --path /PATH (default /; used for Btrfs inspection).

name: collect-support-bundle
description: Build a private support report containing selected system, storage, network, service, and package metadata.
flags: --include-network yes|no (default yes); --include-packages yes|no (default yes); --package-limit COUNT (default 200, maximum 1000).

name: get-performance-snapshot
description: Collect bounded CPU, memory, disk counters, load, process names, and pressure-stall snapshots.
flags: --samples COUNT (default 5, maximum 10); --interval-seconds SECONDS (default 1, maximum 5).

name: audit-boot-and-kernel-errors
description: Summarize kernel error classes for a selected boot and list crash metadata without exporting raw messages or dumps.
flags: --boot current|previous (default current); --entries COUNT (default 1000, maximum 10000).

name: audit-security-policy-denials
description: Check SELinux/AppArmor state, a selected path's label metadata, and bounded denial counts without disabling protection.
flags: --path /PATH (default /); --entries COUNT (default 1000, maximum 10000).

name: check-restart-requirements
description: Report reboot indicators, supported library/service restart hints, and running-kernel module availability without restarting anything.
flags: No script-specific flags.

name: audit-users-and-groups
description: Audit local account IDs, account state, home directories, and local versus NSS identities.
flags: --user NAME (optional detailed account state).

name: audit-elevated-access
description: Audit privileged group membership and sudo/doas policy metadata without exposing policy command arguments.
flags: No script-specific flags.

name: audit-ssh-access
description: Audit effective SSH access policy and selected public-key fingerprints and file permissions.
flags: --user NAME (optional local account); --client-address IP and --client-host HOST (both needed with user for Match evaluation).

name: provision-local-user
description: Create a new local account with optional local groups, expiry, and one public SSH key.
flags: --user NAME (required); --groups GROUP1,GROUP2; --expires YYYY-MM-DD; --public-key PATH. Requires an unused /home/NAME; password remains locked.

name: audit-domain-integration
description: Audit realmd, SSSD, winbind, Kerberos prerequisites, and domain identity resolution without rejoining.
flags: --identity NAME (optional directory identity to resolve); --domain NAME (optional DNS SRV lookup).

name: initialize-technician-workstation
description: Plan or install an approved technician support-tool profile using native distribution packages.
flags: --profile minimal|technician (default minimal). Review the generated manifest before --apply.

name: configure-workstation-baseline
description: Plan or configure an explicit hostname, timezone, or existing generated locale.
flags: --hostname NAME; --timezone AREA/CITY; --locale LOCALE (at least one required). Locale must already be generated.

name: configure-time-synchronization
description: Configure approved NTP sources for the single active chrony or timesyncd daemon, with separate restart confirmation.
flags: --servers HOST1,HOST2 (required); --daemon auto|chrony|timesyncd|ntpd (default auto). Chrony keeps other sources; ntpd requires manual review.

name: configure-endpoint-firewall
description: Add one approved port rule to an already active UFW or firewalld policy while preserving management access.
flags: --port 1..65535 (required); --protocol tcp|udp (default tcp); --backend auto|ufw|firewalld; --zone NAME (firewalld required); --source CIDR (UFW optional).

name: test-workstation-readiness
description: Test a workstation against an explicit resource and capability baseline.
flags: --min-memory-mb NUMBER (default 4096); --min-root-free-mb NUMBER (default 10240); --required-commands comma-list (default curl,ssh); --dns-name HOST (optional).
